_note: Paste into the portal to log the MCC visit as a formal action. 'action' must be one of the entity enum values; 'user_action' is the correct choice for a founder field visit. Set actor_email to your account email. Fill the visit date in 'detail' after the visit.
detail: Founder field visit to Malabar Cancer Centre (MCC), Thalassery, Kannur — oncology-first DPYD / fluoropyrimidine-toxicity pilot discovery. Logged PilotLead (status: discovery_scheduled). Tier-1 ask: anonymized PCR + toxicity spreadsheet (~400-500 patients), exact 7-variant panel, and the count of Grade 3+ toxicity among panel-all-negative patients. Left behind: one-pager + MOU outline. Demo: DPYD/5-FU flow incl. honest refusal on non-core South-Asian variants. Visit date: TBD.
